primary_process_signature: no reproducible treatment effect on candidate processes or reproductive output
required_measurements: orientation assignment; achieved orientation; early/later bouts; wetting; pollen viability; antagonist exposure; total and filled achenes
decision_rule: do not call support for null until a smallest-effect-of-interest is frozen after a blinded variance pilot; before that use null-compatible only
falsifier: a reproducible treatment effect reaching filled-achene output
claim_boundary: Absence of significance is not evidence of no orientation effect.

primary_process_signature: orientation changes early head microclimate and/or early effective-contact efficiency; all-day visit totals may remain unchanged; reproductive output changes in the same functional direction
required_measurements: time window; head surface temperature; air temperature; effective contacts; pollinator visits; final achenes
decision_rule: working support only if treatment changes an early-window process and final reproductive output; all-day visit count is secondary
falsifier: fitness changes without an early-window process shift, or only all-day visits change without effective-contact/fitness linkage
claim_boundary: Path support is mechanistic consistency, not a formal mediated fraction unless mediation assumptions are separately justified.

primary_process_signature: orientation changes rain/wetting exposure and pollen viability or presentation after wetting events, with a corresponding reproductive-output effect
required_measurements: recent rainfall; capitulum wetness; pollen wetting; pollen viability; final achenes
decision_rule: working support only from wetting-event contrasts linking treatment to wetness/viability and reproductive output
falsifier: no treatment effect on wetness or pollen viability despite adequate wetting exposure, while fitness changes through another channel
claim_boundary: Dry-period observations cannot falsify this mechanism.

primary_process_signature: orientation changes antagonist visitation/damage and final reproductive output
required_measurements: antagonist events; florivory; seed-predator evidence/damage; final achenes
decision_rule: working support only if treatment changes antagonist exposure/damage and reproductive output
falsifier: fitness changes with no antagonist-response difference under adequate enemy exposure
claim_boundary: Low enemy years are low-information rather than evidence against the mechanism.

primary_process_signature: two or more candidate channels change in a coordinated way so that net fitness improves without requiring higher all-day visitation
required_measurements: ORI1 plus ORI2 and/or ORI3 measurements
decision_rule: working support if at least two preregistered process families show treatment-linked changes and final reproductive output changes; preserve channel-specific estimates
falsifier: only one channel changes, or process changes do not reach reproductive output
claim_boundary: This is the focal Cirsium test of interaction partitioning/trade-off mitigation, not a claim of universal mechanism.

primary_process_signature: orientation changes final reproductive output but none of the preregistered process channels accounts for a corresponding process shift
required_measurements: all ORI1-ORI3 measurements plus final achenes
decision_rule: classify as unresolved mechanism; do not retrofit a new mediator after seeing the outcome
falsifier: a preregistered process channel is recovered
claim_boundary: This category prevents forcing a positive fitness effect into the preferred mechanisms.
